# Reasons for decision on repair costs

## ⟦PERSON|Zélin O'Varr⟧ v ⟦ORG|Birch Orbit Repairs Ltd⟧

1. This decision concerns the cost of replacing a display cabinet damaged during collection. Liability for the initial scratch is admitted. The dispute is whether replacement of the whole cabinet was a reasonable response when the glass panel could have been repaired separately.

2. The claimant produced two repair estimates. The defendant relied on a catalogue showing a lower replacement price but accepted that the listed cabinet had different dimensions. I give that catalogue limited weight because it does not establish the cost of a suitable substitute.

3. The independent assessor, Dr ⟦PERSON|Ysolde Qhenn⟧, explained that removing the panel would disturb the supporting frame. Her evidence was measured and consistent with the photographs. I accept her estimate of the necessary labour.

4. The assessor used the initials ⟦PERSON|Y. Q.⟧ on the inspection sheet. That sheet concerns the same cabinet and does not describe a second inspection. The initials are evidence of authorship, not a separate business name.

5. I award GBP 690 for repair and GBP 85 for inspection. The claim for storage charges is dismissed because no charge was incurred. Payment is due within twenty-eight days. The order takes effect on 5 November 2026, subject to any application under rule 40.12.

Recorded by ⟦PERSON|Ceryn Nove⟧, judicial clerk.
